scope: Photo registration and floor material research only. No Unreal execution, scene mutation or project-asset modification.
registration_status: The floor's appearance and several local dark-band relationships are visible, but a defensible world-coordinate registration to the current user G-floor model is not established.

observations: Light beige terrazzo contains distinct dark, grey and pale angular chips; broad charcoal terrazzo strips have many contrasting white chips.

Visible dark bands cross the foreground and connect around the visible column-base zone. At least two broad transverse portions and a connecting diagonal-in-perspective portion are visible; this is not merely thin black grout.
Fine slab joints are present inside the pale field. The dark band layout is only partially visible; people, furniture, muddy water and image boundaries hide parts.
The image includes tall windows on two adjacent wall directions, a cross on the far wall, pale patterned column wraps and blue fans.
The floor is wet and muddy during cleanup. Strong mirror reflections and yellow-brown water colour are not the dry normal material.
not_recovered: Correspondence to current UE doors and shop

observations: Dry-looking foreground is pale warm-grey/beige terrazzo with clearly contrasted aggregate and fine slab joints.
A broad dark speckled band passes in front of the standing group and meets the right visible column-base area.

Tall windows, a cross, pale rectangular-pattern column wrap, blue fans and exposed white beams are consistent with the 2023 hall, viewed from another direction. This is a visual correspondence inference, not a solved camera transform.
People cover the band's far edge and most of the hall. The image cannot supply a complete floor layout.

sources.text_extraction_result: All 36 pages are raster scans, so keyword matching alone returned no content. All pages were subsequently rendered and visually reviewed.

relevant_pages.observation: Lower-right normal dining close-up shows white tables and blue independent chairs. People and tables conceal the floor and room boundaries; this does not locate floor strips, beams or entrances.
Orange-shirt serving-food photo is a known reused image, not a new independent angle.
Large boarding group photograph is in a different bright activity room with cabinet wall; it cannot be used to substitute the dining hall's surfaces.
Lower-right image is a library/bookshelf setting, not a dining-window position.

sources.limit: Publication title and upload date do not establish the capture dates of its photographs. No new registered whole-dining-room panorama was found.

registration_barriers: Current reconstruction specifications put major dining windows on the two opposite v-boundary walls, whereas the clear 2023 photo shows windows on adjacent wall directions. The current model windows must not be treated as solved photo correspondences merely because both have windows.
The user's relative plan provides shop, three doors, sink, fountain and nearby courtyards, but none is unambiguously identified together with the black floor bands in the reviewed photographs.
A cross, blue fan or generic column alone is not a unique surveyed control point. No exact similarity/homography-to-world transform is justified.
The room's model area and storey height are pre-existing model estimates; they cannot convert photographic band widths or column spacing into measured values.
safe_changes_without_new_layout_assumpti: Improve the general dry light terrazzo's aggregate contrast and preserve its average colour at long distance.
Keep the material low-to-moderately glossy rather than copying water reflections.
Prepare a dark speckled terrazzo material for later use, but do not assign invented black-band strips or slab joints across the room.
Preserve the previously chosen neutral white paint while geometry registration remains unresolved.

shader_review.finding: The first shader visibly fades toward nearly plain light beige in the distance. Its unresolved grain path mixes a layer average containing only 0.16 aggregate contribution at a further 0.30 blend, so it does not conserve the visible chip-mask mean. The material also reads as fine sand more than the contrasted angular chips in the dry 2021 photo.

uncalibrated_roi_comparison.notice: Different exposure, camera, surface distance and pixel scale: these are directional contrast diagnostics only, not measured albedo or a fidelity score.

shader_review.returns: result['materials']['floor'] and result['materials']['paint']; also material_paths, created and reused_untouched
changes: Moderately increase coarse-chip mask coverage while retaining millimetre-scale chips; do not enlarge grains into gravel.
Increase dark/grey chip share while keeping a light beige matrix and pale chips.

Numerically integrate each proposed layer over 300000 sample positions and use that mask's coverage and colour moments for the unresolved average; blend between resolved colour and the integrated average.
Retain analytic edge filtering, dry roughness 0.55, no relief/displacement and neutral white paint sRGB (231,230,225).
No black-band grid, floor-joint grid or geometry is introduced.
shader_review.numerical_sampling_warning: The calculated coverages 0.19391 and 0.1614633 describe the proposed shader, not measured real-world aggregate percentages.
shader_review.validation: New Python builder syntax checked only. No UE execution or shader compilation was performed by this agent. Parent must inspect compile errors and lit near/far views.
